description: Building Construction/Demolition Violations is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This data set includes all Open and Closed building construction/demolition violation folders. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are building permit, cleared permit. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is open-government-licence-toronto. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
